content.value_statement: Building reusable AI skills requires clear structure, resource planning, and validation. This skill guides teams through skill design, implementation, packaging, and iteration.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required structure for SKILL.md and optional resource folders.
Guides planning for scripts, references, and assets based on real use cases.
Provides an initializer script that creates a template skill folder.
Validates skill frontmatter, naming rules, and basic folder requirements.
Packages a validated skill folder into a distributable zip archive.
Gives iteration guidance for improving skills after real use.
limitations: It does not automatically prove that bundled scripts are secure.
The validator checks basic structure, not full marketplace policy compliance.
Generated templates still require author review and domain-specific content.
Packaging may include any file placed inside the selected skill folder.

use_cases.title: Create a New Agent Skill
use_cases.description: Plan and scaffold a skill with clear instructions, reusable resources, and basic validation.

use_cases.title: Improve an Existing Skill
use_cases.description: Review a current skill, refine its instructions, and remove unnecessary resources.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Skill for Sharing
use_cases.description: Validate the skill folder and package it into a zip file for distribution.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a simple reusable workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a skill plan for a task I repeat often. Ask for missing details, then propose the skill name, description, and core workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Skill Skeleton
prompt_templates.scenario: Scaffold a new skill with required files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a new skill for [task]. Include the folder structure, SKILL.md outline, and any scripts or references that are justified.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Revise a current skill for clarity and lower maintenance cost.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this existing skill and improve its trigger description, instructions, and resource usage. Keep only files that directly support the workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Complex Skill System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced design for a skill with multiple workflows or resource types.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a robust skill for [domain]. Separate core instructions from references, define validation steps, and explain how to forward-test realistic tasks.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for recurring PDF cleanup tasks.
output: A proposed skill name and trigger description.
A concise workflow for common PDF cleanup operations.
A recommendation for helper scripts and validation steps.

output_examples.input: Review my existing data-analysis skill before publishing.
output: A focused list of instruction gaps and redundant files.
Suggested edits for clearer triggers and resource loading.

output_examples.input: Package this skill so I can share it with my team.
output: A packaged archive path when validation succeeds.
Clear next steps when validation fails.

best_practices: Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed reference material into separate files.
Add scripts only when deterministic behavior or repeated automation justifies them.
Validate and test representative workflows before packaging a skill.
anti_patterns: Do not add broad documentation files that do not support skill execution.
Do not hide critical trigger guidance deep inside reference files.
Do not package placeholder resources that users must delete later.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create AI skills with clear triggers, instructions, reusable resources, validation, and packaging steps.

faq.question: Can it update an existing skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives guidance for reviewing, editing, validating, and iterating on an existing skill.

faq.question: Does it include automation scripts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes scripts for initializing, validating, and packaging skill folders.

faq.question: Does validation guarantee marketplace approval?
faq.answer: No. Validation checks basic structure and naming, but marketplace review may require additional policy checks.

faq.question: Can Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Should every skill include scripts and assets?
faq.answer: No. Add scripts, references, or assets only when they directly improve the skill workflow.
